svg.title: Engine selection for engine = auto
svg.desc: With engine set to auto, ideal circuits run on the statevector (or density matrix when requested); noisy circuits run as an exact density matrix when it is cheaper than one trajectory per shot and fits, and as batched Monte-Carlo trajectories otherwise or when a time-correlated term is active.
svg.text: time-correlated = leakage or quasi-static detuning; cheaper = 2ⁿ ≤ 4T and n ≤ 12 (QPUTWIN_DENSITY_AUTO_MAX_QUBITS)
fits = ρ in memory (in place: 1.5·16·4ⁿ B); T = min(shots, QPUTWIN_MAX_TRAJECTORIES)
